newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Pan Pacific buys more Channel KTV shares.
newsitem.headline: Pan Pacific buys more Channel KTV shares.

text.p: Pan Pacific Public Company Ltd said on Tuesday it had purchased an additional 100,000 ordinary shares of Singapore $1.00 each in Channel KTV Pte Ltd at $4.97 per share.
The company added in a statement that Carlton Communications Plc will also be purchasing 100,000 ordinary shares on the same terms.
Following the purchase of the shares, Pan Pacific group and Carlton will commit to a financing shceme where they will further invest a total of S$5 million each in Channel KTV.

Last September, Pan Pacific agreed to subscribe for one million convertible preference shares of Singapore $1.00 each at S$4.97 per share, representing 31.25 percent of Channel KTV for S$4.97 million.
Channel KTV is in the karaoke music television business which broadcasts music videos over satellites, cable television and in clubs and hotels.
